title: Weight-chain reassociation vs Inductor
summary: Deep x @ W1 @ … @ Wk chains: the e-graph finds the weights-first form (one runtime GEMM) and the post-grad FX capture proves Inductor cannot reach it.

findings.claim: catopt reaches a weight-folded form Inductor's post-grad graph cannot express
findings.headline: 4.10× vs Inductor at (k,d,B·T)=(4,512,4096) (4.21× vs eager)

findings.claim: every timed cell passes the fp32 equivalence gate
findings.headline: 2/2 cells verified
